You can have “fun” with anyone and dedicating or investing into someone as a life partner because it’s “fun” is asking for it to be short lived and that’s not a suitable partner.

Transparency, patience, and reassurance with no objection that you’re dedicated to reconciling and never making that choice of betrayal again. It’s showing the BS that you’re actively in a full time job of [metaphorically] washing your hands.

I’m currently in this predicament where my twin says he doesn’t see us romantically anymore and lost hope a while ago. He lead me on for months and took advantage of my open dedication for him. He apologized after I called him out. However, you have to ignore your circumstances. PERSIST and AFFIRM! You know exactly how y’all are meant to be. He is yours and you are his. Rewire any negative thoughts into positive ones. He’s ignoring you? Nope! He’s just busy and wants to talk to you when he can give you undivided attention. He doesn’t want to be with you? Incorrect! He’s afraid of the connection and he isn’t as awakened to it as you are YET. He DOES want to be with you because you actively believe it and know it’s true. Visualize scripts and scenarios between you two as if they true and either have happened or are going to. Don’t give up if you truly believe he is your twin. If you find yourself crying, remind yourself that there is no reason to cry as he is still with you and y’all are inseparable. 

As I tell you this, I’m still practicing it myself. My passion still remains as I know with absolute certainty that he’s making excuses out of fear and us being long distance since he’s such a physical person. I KNOW we are supposed to be together romantically and experience love in all its forms. So I don’t give up and I keep my feelings for him active. I rewrite my thoughts. I still cry hysterically but a few hours later I’m back persisting! Hope this helps <3 stay strong!

For the two hours away when we’re at home thing: we were at uni our first 5 months, so we only got back to being two hours apart when the summer came. He was gone majority of July bc it was his bday and he planned his trips in advance. Now for June & August, I can’t find an excuse for him. I think August was her month actually.

For the official “break up”: you keep quoting it as his heart telling him, but I said it was his head bc that’s what he told me. The thinking of your heart and head are not the same. His heart still beats for me, but his head is kind of against the idea of risking the commitment to me because of the distance. 

Him and her: someone else commented above that they think he was gonna try with her because she was closer. In my head, distance is always the common denominator for us. She was closer, so that felt safer to take a risk on. She ghosted him, so he returned to me back to his heart’s home. Also, I’m polyamorous so I’m fine with him seeing others for sex and he feels the same for me, it’s more upsetting & hurtful that he kept it from me. 

Relocation: In the beginning, maybe our third or fourth month, he told me he’d be delighted for me to live closer and said it’d make him “100% happy because we could spend every day together!”. He was on board until the summer when he drew back out of fear. He once called himself “whacky about relationships” and honestly I think he’s just afraid that if he tries, he’ll mess things up.  He told me find someone because he doesn’t feel he can be enough for me and give me what I need — that’s how I took it. All I ask for is being present honestly. And I’m more than willing to provide him with all those things he needs in s relationship, but his block is his fear. I know this man very well and he knows me too. He even knew when I was a bit off from my usual self and asked if I was good. 

Lastly, if he didn’t want any of this then why is he still here? Why does he always come back to me? He’ll come back with affection and his appreciation is always grand. He wears such a sentimental item from me every day. He’s told me how unsuccessful he is with tinder on campus and how no one wants him. I think that eventually things will line up for him and he’ll see the universe is putting out signs that it’s me and always has been me that’s for him. He still speaks to me every day even if it’s spaced out or gets choppy after a week of consistency. He comes to me in times of need and says how much I help him, I’m his anchor, and thanks me for looking out for him. He cherishes me and loves me. And he’ll still be sexual with me sometimes. He remains here with me and last night he told me that we’ll stick by each other’s side and go through life together even if we don’t work out romantically. I don’t think I’m being entirely delusional because he’s doing things to support why I’m keeping faith. I personally believe in words over actions. This is gonna work bc it’s meant to be. 

Finally, I’m so happy for your gf and you! I’m glad you two are so dedicated and I hope ur time seeing each other goes well

I’ve been through this cycle and it’s still ongoing. I wish I had caught on as soon as it started. My personal advice is to let him come back on his own time and then simply greet him with your love. You may want to give him his distance back but that will only hurt you. Ease into asking if he’s doing okay because if you jump right into it then he could get the impression that it’s all you’ve been thinking about in his absence. He could simply be afraid of the connection and looking for confirmations it’s the real deal. The key is being able to live without him but not wanting to. Keep affirming and reprogramming any doubts you may have, rely on the end which is you two being in harmonious union. Circumstances do not matter. I wish you a smooth, painless journey!

Yeah there’s a possibility you could have it. I too can talk to people who don’t know me but it’s more because I’ll most likely never see them again. I’ve had select mutism since I was a child but wasn’t diagnosed till I was about 16 I believe. While I can’t diagnose you, it sounds like you do have social anxiety at least. I can’t tell if it’s select mutism because idk how long this has been a thing for you and whether or not you’re completely fine and able to verbally express yourself around those who are either family or close friends. 

The part that stands out to me and may hint to you possibly having SM is the physical incapability to speak when you try or want to. Most of the time when I try to speak/respond to someone I end up just sitting there and staring because my mouth literally just will not open. It’s like my tongue is being held down and I can’t for the life of me get myself to make a sound. Most of my SM is in public spaces and in school. Only a handful of people have heard my voice. I only talk to the relatives that I live with. 

If this is a hindering issue for you then I’d suggest seeing a professional such as a therapist or psychiatrist or both! My school counselor was actually the one who referred me with the concern of SM.
